vendor.notes: Natural-stone + porcelain distributor (Anaheim, CA). Marble/travertine/limestone/granite/quartzite/dolomite tile, slabs, mosaics, patterns, medallions & trim, plus imported porcelain (Florim, Rondine, Keraben, etc.). Price lists = Roma cost; retail = cost x1.6 keystone. FOB Anaheim. Office 1415 S. Vernon St, Anaheim CA 92805 / (714) 780-0999.
